dummy.label: training dummy
dummy.how: a boss-level (63) training dummy with only your own buffs (the class's self-buffs and the spec's standard consumables, no raid or party buffs, no debuffs from others), execute phases as a dying boss, phase-1 gear, 120 s: the setting that ranks the raid DPS builds (Forever)

dummy60.label: level-60 dummy
dummy60.how: an in-game style dummy: level 60, never dies (no execute phase), your own buffs and consumables only (Forever; the Classic sim: no buffs and no consumables), phase-1 gear, 120 s

raid.label: raid
raid.how: phase-1 gear, full raid buffs and debuffs minus the buff this spec brings itself, the standard raid consumables, 120 s

max.label: maximum
max.how: the best gear preset of the spec, every raid buff and debuff on (own buff supplied by someone else), consumables (and the Classic sim's world buffs), 120 s

max60.label: maximum, 60 s
max60.how: as maximum with a 60 s fight: cooldowns weigh more
